div.head: Ine 34.1
div.ab: Gif his wergild sy CC scll', gebete mid L scll', ⁊ þa ilcan ryhte do mon be ðam diorborenran.
Gif his wergield sie CC scill., gebete mid L scill., ⁊ ðy ilcan ryhte do man be ðam deorborenran.
Si eius weregildum sit CC solidorum, emendet L sol., et idem rectum fiat de carius genitis.
Gif his wergield sie CC sciƚƚ, gebete mid L sciƚƚ, ⁊ ðy ilcan ryhte do man be ðæm deorborenran.
If his wergild is 200 shillings, let him compensate with 50 shillings and the same law applies to someone nobly born.

If his [the slain man's] wergeld is 200 shillings, he must pay 50 shillings compensation; and in the case of a man of nobler birth the proportion [between the compensation and the wergeld] shall be the same.
If his wergild is 200 shillings, he is to pay 50 shillings compensation; and one is to proceed with the same proportion in the case of the nobler born.
wenn dessen Wergeld 200 Schill. ist, büsse er [sie] mit 50 Schill., und mit demselben Rechtsmasse verfahre man bei dem adligeren [Erschlagenen].
if his wergeld is 200 shillings, let him pay [for it] with 50 shillings, and let the same measure of law be applied in the case of a [slain man] of nobler birth.
